dashboard_heading: Let the donkey do the donkey work.
dashboard_empty: Your dashboard fills up once you track applications, tasks and interviews.
applications_empty: No applications yet. Soon you can add them here or share a job posting to Jofi.
companies_empty: No companies yet. They appear here as you add applications and contacts.
tasks_empty: No tasks yet. Follow-ups and reminders will show up here.
chat_empty: The chat with Jofi arrives soon. It will know your applications and help with the next step.
not_found_body: This page does not exist. Maybe the link is outdated.
share_intro: Jofi received this from your share sheet. Importing job postings from shared links arrives in a later version.
share_empty: Nothing was shared. Use your device's share sheet and pick Jofi.
password_rules: 15 to 256 characters. A long passphrase of a few words is easy to remember and hard to guess.
login_intro: Log in to continue with your job search.
session_expired: Your session has ended. Please log in again.
first_run_intro: Choose the password you will use to log in. Jofi has one user: you.
setup_token_hint: Proves that you run this server. Read it on the server with:
setup_token_wrong: The setup token is wrong. Copy it again from the server.
first_run_done_elsewhere: Jofi is already set up. Log in with your password.
password_change_intro: All other devices are logged out afterwards.
password_change_done: Your password was changed. Other devices are logged out.
throttled: Too many failed attempts. Please wait {seconds} seconds and try again.
error_generic: Jofi could not complete this request (HTTP {status}). Please try again.
error_unavailable: Jofi is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.
error_offline: Jofi cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error_csrf: Your security token expired. Reload the page and try again.
error_weak_password: The password does not meet the rules: 15 to 256 characters.
error_other_sessions_remain: The password was changed, but other devices could not be logged out. Change it once more.
